Asymmetric antenna-path channel sounding is supported as shipped in this
release. The 1-antenna initiator presets ship with 4 antenna paths
(`*_cent_a1_4`), so every shipped initiator-reflector antenna combination
(A1_B2, A1_B4, A2_B2) passes the controller's antenna-config validation.
Previously every asymmetric pair was rejected at Set Procedure Parameters on
both devices (HCI 0x0d) and no channel sounding ran (#134); the controller
itself was never the problem (#135). Spec: #139.

**Preset renames — scripted build flows must move.** The `*_cent_a1_1`
initiator preset names are gone: ublox, fanstel, and minew (plus their `_ipt`
twins) are renamed to `*_cent_a1_4` on the 4-path/1-antenna fragment, and
`nrf54l15dk_cent_a1_1` is dropped in favour of the pre-existing
`nrf54l15dk_cent_a1_4`. Scripts and CI invocations that name presets must
switch from `_a1_1` to `_a1_4`; the full shipped matrix is
[docs/hardware.md](https://github.com/Metirionic/mars-cs-nrf54l/blob/v1.13.0/docs/hardware.md#presets).

**Known issue (#138)** — the nRF54L15 TAG reflector can freeze under sustained
asymmetric ranging: sporadic, observed ~2–15 min into a session (#135). The
session tears down by design and auto-recovers without re-flashing: the
initiator sees RAS serialization stop, then the supervision-timeout disconnect
(reason 0x08) a few seconds later, and the devices come back through the
designed recovery path — the disconnect-callback cold reboot
(`common/ble_callbacks.c`) and the CS liveness watchdog (#116). Root cause
under investigation in #138; it does not gate this release.

Verification status (#141): the asymmetric pair (`nrf54l15dk_cent_a1_4` ↔
`nrf54l15tag_peri_a2_4`, A1_B2) and the 2↔2 / 2↔1 / 1↔1 regression trio are
bench-verified, with real 4-path A2_B2 proven on the Ezurio pair. Genuine 1↔4
(A1_B4) is logic-verified only — no 4-antenna peer exists on the bench. The
non-DK board and IPT presets are build-verified only. A dedicated
`nrf54l15dk_peri_a2_4` reflector preset is tracked as #145.
